serviceName: Outrank Blog on a root domain
description: Connects a root domain (for example example.com) to the blog Outrank hosts for the customer on Vercel. The apex group adds the A record and Outrank's ownership TXT record. The optional vercel-verification group adds the TXT record Vercel asks for when the domain is already used on another Vercel account; it is marked OnApply, so removing it later leaves the blog's records in place.
variableDescription: %ip%: the IPv4 address Vercel recommends for the root domain, as Outrank shows it (for example 76.76.21.21). %ownershiptoken%: the ownership token Outrank generated for this domain. %vercelverification%: Vercel's TXT value after vc-domain-verify= (the full host name, a comma, then Vercel's code).
